headline.en: Set up dev environment for AI agents

scenario.zh: 你的团队正在构建AI驱动的客户分析功能,需要快速配置开发和测试环境
scenario.en: Your team is building an AI-powered customer analytics feature and needs to configure dev and test environments quickly

instruction.zh: 为项目选择基础架构配置方式
instruction.en: Select infrastructure configuration approach for your project

output.zh: 环境在常规时间内就绪,适合传统工作流程
output.en: Environment ready in standard time, suitable for traditional workflows

output.zh: 环境配置明显加快,专为AI编码代理工作流程优化
output.en: Environment setup significantly faster, optimized for AI coding agent workflows

instruction.zh: 选择如何运行集成测试套件
instruction.en: Choose how to run your integration test suite

output.zh: 测试按传统顺序完成,结果稳定
output.en: Tests complete in traditional sequence, results stable

output.zh: 测试时间大幅缩短,反馈循环更快
output.en: Test time substantially reduced, feedback loop much faster

instruction.zh: 对比不同基础设施配置的构建效率
instruction.en: Compare build efficiency across infrastructure configurations

output.zh: 构建在预期时间内完成,资源使用标准
output.en: Build completes in expected time, resource usage standard

output.zh: 构建速度提升显著,AI代理迭代更流畅
output.en: Build speed noticeably improved, AI agent iterations smoother

instruction.zh: 查看团队开发环境的最终配置
instruction.en: Review final configuration of your team's development environment

output.zh: 团队可以开始构建和测试客户分析功能
output.en: Team ready to build and test customer analytics feature

output.zh: AI代理和开发者可以快速验证代码变更
output.en: AI agents and developers can rapidly validate code changes

takeaway.zh: 针对AI代理优化的基础设施让开发团队更快构建、测试和部署软件
takeaway.en: Infrastructure optimized for AI agents enables dev teams to build, test and deploy software faster
